doc: Allocates a load-buffer sized from `(((s16)s->unk4)>>1) * s->unk6` via func_80040574, zeroes that many ints via func_8003DB4C, then calls LoadImage(s, buffer). The size expression is written twice in source (once per call site) rather than cached in a local, which is why gcc recomputes it (lhu+sll+sra+mult) fresh after the intervening call instead of keeping it live across the call in a saved register.
calls: func_80040574(s32 size) -> s32 (returns allocated buffer pointer as int)
func_8003DB4C(int *p, int n) -- already matched, zeroes n ints at p
LoadImage(void *rect, s32 *p) -- PSX BIOS call, args only
